_format.description: Indian tax rates and calculation rules per financial year and per regime. Loaded and strictly validated at application startup by TaxRuleRegistry; an invalid or incomplete entry fails the boot rather than silently mis-computing tax.
editing: Add a financial year by appending to financialYears, oldest-first ordering by convention.
All monetary amounts and rates are JSON STRINGS so they parse as exact BigDecimal, never binary floats.
Set verified=true only once the figures are checked against an authoritative source.
Run `mvn test -Dtest=TaxRuleRegistryTest` after editing; the tests pin known figures.

fields.verified: true if checked against an authoritative source; false means best-effort, needs a CA review.
fields.periods: One entry unless rates changed mid-year. Periods must be contiguous and together cover 1 April to 31 March exactly.
fields.periods[].effectiveFrom/effectiveTo: Inclusive ISO dates bounding the period.
fields.periods[].cessRate: Health and education cess applied to total tax of every kind.
fields.periods[].note: Provenance or caveat. Surfaced in review and in the API.
fields.capitalGains.ltcgRate: Long-term rate on equity and equity-oriented MF. "0" means exempt (s.10(38) era, FY 2004-05 to FY 2017-18).
fields.capitalGains.ltcgExemption: Annual exemption on long-term equity gains. "0" where none applies.
fields.capitalGains.cryptoRate: Flat rate on virtual digital assets under s.115BBH, which begins FY 2022-23.
fields.capitalGains.longTermThresholdDays: Holding days at or above which a disposal is long-term, per AssetType.
fields.capitalGains.defaultLongTermDays: Fallback threshold for asset types not listed.
fields.deductions: Chapter VI-A ceilings: 80C, 80CCD(1B) NPS, 80D self, 80D senior-citizen parents.
fields.regimes: Keyed by TaxRegime. OLD is required. NEW exists only from FY 2020-21 (s.115BAC); asking for it in an earlier year is an error.
fields.regimes.*.slabs: Ascending by upTo. Marginal: only income inside a band is taxed at its rate. Exactly one slab has upTo=null and it must be last, meaning 'and above'.
fields.regimes.*.standardDeduction: Salary standard deduction. "0" where none applied that year.
fields.regimes.*.rebate: Section 87A: tax reduced by up to maxRebate when taxable income is at or below incomeThreshold. Both "0" where no rebate existed.
fields.regimes.*.surchargeBands: Ascending by incomeAbove. The highest band whose threshold the income exceeds applies.
fields.regimes.*.surchargeCap: Maximum surcharge rate, or null for uncapped. The new regime caps at "0.25" where the old regime reaches "0.37".
fields.regimes.*.allowsDeductions: Whether chapter VI-A deductions and HRA may be claimed under this regime.
fields.capitalGains.otherAssetLtcgRate: Long-term rate on gold, SGB and real estate. Indexation is NOT modelled, so for periods where indexation applied (before 23 Jul 2024) the computed tax is an upper bound.
fields.slab-rated classes: Debt funds, FDs and bonds, plus short-term gold and property, are taxed at the taxpayer's slab rate. That depends on total income, which the capital gains calculator does not see, so those gains are reported with taxAtSlabRate=true and no fabricated tax figure.

s.87A rebate Rs 5,000; surcharge 15%. Gold/property LTCG 20% with indexation; indexation is not modelled so that figure is an upper bound

s.112A reintroduces equity LTCG at 10% over Rs 1L with 31 Jan 2018 grandfathering; standard deduction returns at Rs 40,000; cess 4%. Gold/property LTCG 20% with indexation; indexation is not modelled so that figure is an upper bound

Standard deduction Rs 50,000; s.87A rebate Rs 12,500 up to Rs 5L; surcharge bands extended to 25% and 37%. Gold/property LTCG 20% with indexation; indexation is not modelled so that figure is an upper bound
s.115BAC introduces the optional new regime: seven bands, no standard deduction. Gold/property LTCG 20% with indexation; indexation is not modelled so that figure is an upper bound
New regime unchanged from FY 2020-21. Gold/property LTCG 20% with indexation; indexation is not modelled so that figure is an upper bound
s.115BBH taxes virtual digital assets at a flat 30% with no set-off of losses. Gold/property LTCG 20% with indexation; indexation is not modelled so that figure is an upper bound

New regime becomes the default: six bands, Rs 50,000 standard deduction, s.87A rebate Rs 25,000 to Rs 7L, surcharge capped at 25%. Gold/property LTCG 20% with indexation; indexation is not modelled so that figure is an upper bound
Pre Finance (No. 2) Act 2024: equity LTCG 10% over Rs 1L, STCG 15%. Gold/property LTCG 20% with indexation; indexation is not modelled so that figure is an upper bound
From 23 Jul 2024: equity LTCG 12.5% over Rs 1.25L, STCG 20%; new regime standard deduction raised to Rs 75,000

Verified against a published slab table. Budget 2025 new regime: seven bands from Rs 4L; s.87A rebate Rs 60,000 making income to Rs 12L effectively tax free. Marginal relief just above Rs 12L is NOT yet modelled
Budget 2026 announced no significant slab changes; FY 2025-26 rules carry forward
